newsitem.title: USA: Weston, Fla., to annex Bonaventure neighborhood.
newsitem.headline: Weston, Fla., to annex Bonaventure neighborhood.

text.p: Residents of Florida's Bonaventure neighborhood in west Broward County voted to join City of Weston rather than City of Sunrise by a margin of nearly 2-1, elections officials said Wednesday.
In Tuesday's election, 1,835 Bonaventure voters cast ballots for Weston, and 1,029 chose Sunrise.

The annexation of the previously unincorporated Bonaventure will boost Weston's population by 9,000 or about 37 percent. It will add $285 million in taxable property to Weston's tax base, producing about $440,000 a year in additional property tax revenues and $1.8 million in state revenue sharing.

Both cities had wooed the affluent Bonaventure area. Sunrise, a long established city with 75,000 residents, promised $15.7 million of capital improvements in Bonaventure, including a fire station and branch library.
The smaller and more affluent Weston, a planned community that incorporated last year, offered a more prestigious address and assurances that property values would remain high.
